name: 三种口味混合胶囊咖啡款
description: 纯白棚拍混合装胶囊，三色阵列与冲饮指引逐级建立信任

styleLock.direction: premium coffee-commerce, monochrome pack campaign with metal pod accents
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white cyclorama #FFFFFF for packshots, warm ivory panel #F7F3EC for benefit and variant screens, near-black ink #1C1B1A for macro screens, alternating one panel per screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm neutral studio light, large soft front-left key with bounce fill, controlled specular roll on metal pod shells, soft honest contact shadows, no harsh flash
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm ivory board #F7F3EC and glossy white studio floor with one soft mirror sheen #FFFFFF
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, wide letterspacing, headline in near-black #1C1B1A on white, single weight family only
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in one accent #C9A227, outline only, no filled pictograms, no certification artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on eye-level hero angle for the pack, pod scale identical across the set, three pods always evenly spaced at identical size, one product or one ink panel per screen
noDrift: no added brand marks, monograms or coffee machine hardware
no filled meters, numerals or rating graphics
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium coffee-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, warm ivory panel #F7F3EC, near-black ink #1C1B1A and one antique gold line accent #C9A227; warm neutral studio lighting with a large soft front-left key, bounce fill and controlled specular roll on metal surfaces, soft honest contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letterspacing and a single thin-line icon weight; one product or one ink panel per screen with stable pod scale and eye-level hero angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no added brand marks or appliance hardware, no filled meters or numerals.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 深色盒侧后视角＋三颗不同壳色胶囊一字排开；002 混合装口味列表，每行胶囊＋空/填方格梯度条＋杯型图标＋风味描述；003 产地圆窗遮罩高山种植园＋俯视玻璃杯油脂圈＋产地与农户数量主张；004 胶囊俯视压在咖啡粉堆上＋细线叶片圆环＋回收主张；005 三台咖啡机一字排列＋玻璃杯＋镜面倒影，标注仅适配某机型；006 四杯由冰饮到短浓缩按大小斜排＋免奶说明；007 品牌字＋共益认证印章＋胶囊封口局部裁切特写；008 黑盒正面＋三行色块口味与每行颗数＋三颗胶囊排前。品类判定：图为单次冲饮用胶囊咖啡组合装，需热水萃取冲调，故 L1 逐字取「食品饮料」、L2 逐字取「冲调」，leaf 用「混合口味胶囊咖啡」与库内「中烘拼配意式咖啡豆」在语义上区分（胶囊咖啡 vs 整豆）；源类目若挂咖啡器具或家电均不改判，因主体是胶囊本身。成套判定：多色胶囊阵列伴随口味梯度列表、冲饮杯型谱、产地与回收等信息分镜，非纯色卡轮换，故按可转化处理。已剥离内容：咖啡品牌字标与系列名、胶囊封口圆顶的条纹凹槽与侧壁装饰线等专有装潢、机型外观与机型适配主张、认证印章图形、口味专名、方格内的强度与烘焙度数值、每行颗数与总颗数、农户数量等社会证明数字、原图英文文案原句；上述数值一律改为空梯度条、空参数行、空印章框与「{callout_1}」占位，不在模版中搬运任何事实数值。005 因主体为第三方咖啡机硬件与适配主张，其机位体系并入 004/006 的倒影与杯型分镜，未单列镜头。
